about_the_game:
In this DLC, you can enjoy "Koharu Rikka," who is well-known in singing voice synthesis software and text-to-speech voice synthesis software. The character comes with two types of outfits, summer and winter, which can be switched at any time using the character change function. Additionally, as a feature exclusive to this DLC, "Lakiston" (Koharu Rikka's official mascot) will appear when an alarm notification occurs, cutely informing you of the time.

It also features original recorded voices by Yoshino Aoyama (affiliated with 81 Produce), a popular voice actress who has been active in numerous works. Along with Koharu Rikka's diverse movements and facial expressions on Desktop Mate, you can enjoy communication with her realistic voice. Koharu Rikka, who could previously only be experienced within the world of voice synthesis software, will now bring a new everyday life of spending time together with you on your desktop.

  • Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please also ensure that you are using the latest version.

  • Please use this content in accordance with the "Character Usage Guidelines" on the TOKYO6 ENTERTAINMENT official website.

  • According to these guidelines, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

Contents included in this product

Koharu Rikka
